about: The fixtures (by file or store name) whose layout or verdict their profile changed after the frozen reference (conformance/zarrify/reference) froze, which it does not give: compare.py compares their outputs, and those of their mutants (conformance/zarrify/mutate.py), py with web alone, and the tests that compare the frozen profiles with the Rust core (python/tests/ir/ir_helpers.py, js/test/ir/ir.test.ts) leave them out. NDPI's strips without McuStarts whose frame header is not their level's size (spec/zarrify/ndpi.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ndpi.md#7-ndpi-profile>) its JPEG XR levels, and its focal planes, which the frozen reference rejects (spec/zarrify/ndpi.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ndpi.md#3-levels>); TIFF's LZW images and images in strips (spec/zarrify/tiff.md §4.5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#45-strips>), and its images with Predictor 2 (spec/zarrify/tiff.md §4.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#43-data-types-and-codecs>); and an HDF5 file that is not an Imaris file, which the IMS profile rejected and the HDF5 profile, which chooses IMS, now zarrifies (spec/zarrify/ims.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ims.md#7-ims-profile>). DICOM's lossless JPEG files (transfer syntaxes 1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.57 and 1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.70), whose frames the profile reads since the freeze, and those it rejects for their headers (spec/zarrify/dicom.md §7.5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/dicom.md#75-frames>), which the frozen reference rejects as an unsupported transfer syntax. A store with a node at refkv_source, which the N5 and Zarr v2 profiles reject whether or not the store has other objects, since the IR's mirror is always there (spec/zarrify/n5.md §6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/n5.md#6-other-objects>, spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#5-other-objects>), where the frozen reference rejected it only when there were other objects to keep. A TIFF's image across files and a Micro-Manager stack (spec/zarrify/tiff.md §7.4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#74-several-files>, §7.5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#75-micro-manager-stacks>), which the frozen reference rejects or reads as one plane. DICOM's 1-bit images (spec/zarrify/dicom.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/dicom.md#3-the-image>), which the frozen reference rejects for their Bits Allocated. DICOM's RLE, JPEG-LS and HTJ2K files, its palette images and native YBR_FULL ones (spec/zarrify/dicom.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/dicom.md#3-the-image>), and JPEG 2000 frames of YBR_FULL_422, which the frozen reference rejects, and those the profile rejects for what they hold. NIfTI's complex voxels, which the frozen reference rejects (spec/zarrify/nifti.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nifti.md#3-data-types>). CZI's LZW, lossless JPEG and 12-bit JPEG subblocks (spec/zarrify/czi.md §3.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/czi.md#31-pixel-types-and-codecs>), which the frozen reference rejects.
